AstraExtera worlds

This save has a generated galaxy, star field and planetary system. The server stores one result for every player. AstraTerra draws it and supplies the instruments.

Start here
• Press Ctrl+Shift+S to inspect the galaxy and local system. The Galaxy panel key is remappable.
• Make a Sky Disc to mark sunrise and sunset.
• Use a telescope, a book in the left hand and ink and quill to draw constellations.
• Use the Sextant to record a light's angle and bearing, then compare sightings.
• Cut an Astrolabe plate for your latitude to forecast another observation.

What is different
Earth's constellation templates and deep-sky objects do not belong to this generated catalog. Draw your own figures. Generated companion planets remain points in a telescope.

A planet world can have several moons or none. On a moon world, the parent giant stays fixed in the sky because the world is tidally locked; sibling moons may cross it.

The visible Vintage Story moon is hidden. Moonlight and the calendar phase still come from Vintage Story, so they may not match the generated moons. The generated world facts shown in the panel do not change terrain, gravity, climate, day length or seasons.

If something is not visible
Check the time, season, latitude, horizon, weather and open sky. Some stars never rise at a given latitude, and comets have limited return windows. If two galactic bands overlap, set AstraTerra's MilkyWayBrightness to 0.0 in ModConfig/astraterra.json with the game closed, then restart.
